claim: Château de Bachen (Duhort-Bachen) is Michel & Christine Guérard's own vineyard since 1983, with first vintage 1987, visitable by appointment only Monday-Friday at 10:00 and 15:00 (closed public holidays), bookings via reservation@lespreseugenie.com.
quote: Visits are by appointment only, Monday to Friday (excluding public holidays), at 10:00 AM and 3:00 PM. Reserve via email at reservation@lespreseugenie.com.

claim: Château de Bachen produces three signature labels — Baron de Bachen (white, Sauvignon/Manseng/Baroque blend), Barocco (red), and Rosa la Rose (rosé gastronomique) — on the D39 between Aire-sur-l'Adour and Duhort-Bachen overlooking the Adour valley.
quote: The estate produces three main wines: Rosa la Rose (Rosé Gastronomique), Barocco (red), and Baron de Bachen (white). The white wines blend 'Sauvignon, Menseng and Baroque' varieties... The château, rebuilt in the late 1700s, overlooks the Adour valley.

claim: Cave des Vignerons de Tursan in Geaune is about 15 minutes from Eugénie-les-Bains, open Mon-Fri 9-12 / 14-17:30, Sat 9-12:30 (extended Jul-Sept), with guided tour + 5-wine tasting on Tuesdays April-August at 14:30 (plus 10:00 in Jul-Aug) for €5/person, ~90 min, advance reservation required.
quote: Tours available Tuesdays April-August at 2:30pm (plus 10am July-August). The experience includes 'discovering history, exploring the cave and chai' with 'five wines tasted' during roughly 90-minute visits. Cost: €5 per person (18+)... Distance from Eugénie-les-Bains: Approximately 15 minutes away

claim: Cave des Vignerons de Tursan is a 1958 cooperative grouping ~60 growers across 500 hectares producing AOP Tursan red/rosé/white plus IGP Landes wines, located at 30 rue Saint-Jean, 40320 Geaune, with bottles €4.60–€7.65 and curated wine boxes from €35.40.
quote: Founded in 1958, this cooperative winery brings together approximately 60 wine-growers managing 500 hectares of vineyards... Individual wine prices range from €4.60 to €7.65 per bottle (sold in 6-bottle cases). Curated wine boxes are available starting at €35.40.

claim: Geaune sits roughly 6.2 km as the crow flies (about 8 km / 8–9 min by road) from Eugénie-les-Bains, making the Tursan AOC heartland the closest wine cluster to Les Prés d'Eugénie.
quote: The distance to travel from Geaune to Eugénie-les-Bains is 7.7 km for a total duration of approximately 8 minutes... the distance between Geaune and Eugénie-les-Bains is 6.2 km as the crow flies.

claim: Vignoble Dulucq — Château de Perchade is a family-run Tursan estate at 910 route des Pyrénées, 40320 Payros-Cazautets, open year-round by appointment with free tastings of white/rosé/red and sweet Tursan wines, set on a south-facing clay-limestone slope facing the Pyrenees.
quote: Address: 910 route des Pyrénées, 40320 Payros-Cazautets... Visit Hours: 'All year 2026' with visits 'by appointment'... Prices: Free of charge... A south-facing vineyard overlooking the Pyrenees on clay-limestone soil, characterized by wild orchids.

claim: Château Garreau in Labastide-d'Armagnac hosts the Écomusée de l'Armagnac on an 82-hectare estate combining a 17th-c. Musée du Vigneron, an alembic museum with 10+ stills, an underground cellar unique in Armagnac, botanical/pond trails, and a guided Floc de Gascogne + Armagnac tasting at the end of the visit.
quote: Ecomuseum of Armagnac... Vigneron Museum – Houses over 1,000 traditional tools in a 17th-century Gascon barn... Alambics Museum – Features eleven different distillery apparatus... 'A tasting will be offered at the conclusion of the Ecomuseum visit'... distillery operates November-December

claim: Château Garreau Écomusée pricing in 2026: 'Vigneron' visit €6, 'Prince' visit €12, family pass €14 (2 adults + up to 3 children), Écomusée admission €4.50 adult; the site won the 2025 Œnotourism Trophy.
quote: The Winemaker's visit costs €6, the Prince's visit costs €12, and the family rate is €14 (for 2 adults and up to 3 children). Additionally, admission to the Armagnac Ecomuseum is €4.50 for adults... won the Oenotourism Trophies 2025.

claim: Labastide-d'Armagnac (Château Garreau) is about 34 km in a straight line from Eugénie-les-Bains, putting it at the outer edge of the 30 km radius (still feasible as a half-day Armagnac excursion).
quote: the distance between Eugénie-les-Bains and Labastide-d'Armagnac in a straight line is 34 km.

claim: Domaine Départemental d'Ognoas (1043 route d'Ognoas, 40190 Arthez-d'Armagnac) — property of the Landes département — opens Tue-Fri with afternoon Monday slots; May-Sept 10-12 / 14-18, Oct-Apr 9-12 / 14-17, tastings €2–€5 covering vintage bas-armagnacs and Floc de Gascogne plus visit of the century-old still.
quote: January-April & October-December: Tuesday-Friday 9am-12pm, 2-5pm; Monday 2-5pm; May-September: Tuesday-Friday 10am-12pm, 2-6pm; Monday 2-6pm... Tastings range from €2-€5... vintage bas-armagnacs, its flocs de Gascogne (local fortified wine), aging cellars and its two century old still.

claim: Domaine d'Ognoas spans 565 hectares of forest, vines and meadows with 7 centuries of history and holds the oldest functioning still in Gascogne (1804, listed Monument Historique); guided tours run at 15:00 Oct-Apr and at 10:00 + 15:00 May-Sept, with escape games and Terra Aventura geocaching also on site.
quote: The domain spans 565 hectares and covers 7 centuries of history, featuring its cellars and the presentation of the oldest functioning still in Gascogne from 1804, which is registered as a historic monument... From October 1st to April 30th, guided visits are available at 3pm, and from May 2nd to September 30th, guided visits are available at 10am and 3pm.

claim: Arthez-d'Armagnac (Domaine d'Ognoas) lies about 24 km from Eugénie-les-Bains, comfortably inside the 30 km radius and noticeably closer than Labastide-d'Armagnac.
quote: Eugénie-les-Bains is situated at 24 km from Arthez-d'Armagnac.
